name: Goshujin-sama wa, Otou-san ~Tsuma ni wa Ienai Himitsu no Yuugi~
original_name: ご主人様は、お父さん ～妻には言えないヒミツの遊戯～
source:
...It seems I won't be able to fall asleep right away tonight.

I could pretend to be asleep, but it's a husband's job to satisfy his sexual frustration. I should satisfy my adorable, sexually frustrated wife.

"H...n!? Ngh! Mmm!"

My wife's reaction was different from usual, so I pushed my erect penis into her, rubbing against her lukewarm flesh.

The truth is, although I'd found sex with Chise satisfying, I'd never been satisfied.

That's because I had my ex-wife, Kumi. We were madly in love with each other, and I loved Kumi so much that the thought of cheating never even crossed my mind.

I had planned to spend the rest of my life with Kumi. But— A few years ago, Kumi was in an accident...
"Ah... It's alright, husband... The pain is subsiding... You can do more."

"Pain...?"
The muttering I heard sent chills down my spine.

"But Dad... after you remarried, you only had eyes for that person...

You've always been concerned about me. Am I really that much of a nuisance?"
I gasp.

There, there was a girl named Hazumi, Kumi's daughter who was like a mirror image of Kumi.
translation:
……看来今晚我是睡不着了。

我可以假装睡着，但满足性挫败感是丈夫的工作。我应该满足我可爱的、性欲受挫的妻子。

“嗯……嗯！？嗯！嗯！”

我妻子的反应与平常不同，所以我将勃起的阴茎推入她体内，摩擦着她微温的肌肤。

事实是，虽然我发现与Chise的性爱很令人满意，但我从未感到满足。

那是因为我有前妻久美。我们疯狂地相爱，我也非常爱久美，以至于我从来没有想过出轨。

我本来打算和久美一起度过余生。但是——几年前，久美遭遇了一场事故……
“啊……没关系，丈夫……疼痛正在消退……你可以做得更多。”

“疼痛…？”
听到的嘀咕声让我脊背发凉。

“可是爸爸……你再婚之后，你的眼里就只有那个人了……

你一直都很关心我。我真的有那么麻烦吗？”
我喘息着。

在那里，有一个名叫羽积的女孩，她是久美的女儿，就像久美的镜像一样。
